co2_to_persist.source: Guliyeva et al. (2025) / Archer et al. (2009)
co2_to_persist.notes: Fraction of a one-off CO2 pulse that remains in atmosphere/ocean long enough to show up in persistent pollution stock.

ai_co2_intensity_2020.notes: Direct operational CO2 emitted per 2020-$ of AI output (kg CO2/$ scaled).

ai_ewaste_intensity_2020.source: Guliyeva et al. (2025) / UN E-Waste Monitor / IEA
ai_ewaste_intensity_2020.notes: Life-cycle CO2-equivalent to toxic metals and PFAS in AI hardware discarded in 2020 per dollar spend.

frac_io_ai_2020.source: Guliyeva et al. (2025) / World Bank / IDC
frac_io_ai_2020.notes: Share of total industrial output that is AI/compute in 2020 (1.3%).

frac_io_ai_2050.source: Guliyeva et al. (2025) / OECD / Morgan Stanley
frac_io_ai_2050.notes: Target saturation share of industrial output devoted to AI by 2050 (6.0%).

base_ai_efficiency_improvement.notes: Initial annual fractional improvement in compute energy efficiency.

ai_efficiency_slowdown_rate.notes: Decay rate of compute efficiency gains over time.

ai_ewaste_improvement_rate.source: Guliyeva et al. (2025) / Forti et al. (2020)
ai_ewaste_improvement_rate.notes: Annual circular economy and recycling improvement in hardware e-waste reduction.

ai_accelerator_lifetime_years.notes: Average economic and technical service life of datacenter AI training accelerators.

ai_datacenter_pue_2020.notes: Average Power Usage Effectiveness of modern hyperscale AI facilities.

ai_water_cooling_liters_per_kwh.source: Li et al. (2023) / Nature / Google Environmental Report
ai_water_cooling_liters_per_kwh.notes: Direct onsite cooling water evaporation per kilowatt-hour of datacenter compute load.

ai_productivity_feedback_gain.notes: Elasticity of total factor productivity relative to AI knowledge capital stock.

ai_jevons_rebound_elasticity.notes: Price elasticity of compute demand (elasticity > 1 triggers backfire/Jevons rebound).

climate_sensitivity_ecs.notes: Equilibrium Climate Sensitivity for a doubling of pre-industrial atmospheric CO2.

ocean_heat_capacity_depth.source: Held et al. / Two-box climate response
ocean_heat_capacity_depth.notes: Effective mixed-layer ocean depth for thermal response delay.

renewable_learning_rate.notes: Capex reduction rate per doubling of cumulative installed solar PV & battery capacity.

copper_intensity_kg_per_mw_clean.notes: Copper requirement per MW of renewable generation and grid expansion.

lithium_reserves_mt.notes: Economically recoverable identified global lithium reserves.
